How do you deal with a coworker who is constantly negative and angry?

Don't pry. As long as he/she shows up and gets the work done just leave it alone. Don't try to "be there" or expound some guru pop psychology bullshit. Don't call them out in front of others, like "sorry mr.grumpy, amirite guys?" Just let it ride.
As the one who is negative, just leave them the fuck alone until they are ready. If they piss you off, maybe they are just going through something.

I work in healthcare, so I deal with a lot of pissed off doctors who think they can curse at you because something went wrong. If you don't work directly with the person on a project funnel them to whoever works with them. I work in the lab. If a doctor screams at me because surgery did not collect a sample for me to test I give the doctor the number for surgery and tell him to have a nice day. If he calls back to yell some more I give him surgery's number and then hang up. Subsequent calls are hung up on if he is rude or screaming. If you have to work with a person who is angry first determine if there is something you can fix. Even if it wasn't your fault that something got screwed up take the initiative and fix it. Most rude or angry people are just frustrated. Remove the frustration and the attitude will go with it. If you don't see an immediate problem then calmly and politely say "I'm sorry that something is not working here. I would like to fix it, but I'm unsure of what you need me to do. Please calm down and speak to me in a professional manner, and I will do everything I can to get this resolved quickly." If they are still being rude then say to them "We are both professionals and the way you are speaking to me is not acceptable. If you continue to speak to me that way we will have to reschedule this meeting/phone call/etc because this is currently not a productive atmosphere." If they keep acting like an ass then walk away. If they engage you rudely again then say "I will be happy to help you with this when you can speak to me like a professional. Please come back after you have cooled off a bit." Now this will piss them off even more, but as long as your boss backs you up you will only need to do this once or twice before they learn to be polite when dealing with you.
